issues.issueDescription: The management console ships with a default administrative account whose credentials are not forced to be changed on first login, allowing an attacker with network access to gain full control.
issues.remediationSteps: Disable or reset the default account and enforce mandatory credential rotation on first use.

issues.issueDescription: A deserialization flaw in the messaging queue processor allows an unauthenticated attacker to submit crafted objects that execute arbitrary code when processed.
issues.remediationSteps: Update to the version that enforces type allow-listing during deserialization.

issues.issueDescription: Insufficient access control on the reporting API allows a low-privileged user to retrieve reports belonging to other tenants by incrementing a numeric identifier in the request.
issues.remediationSteps: Implement object-level authorization checks on all reporting endpoints.
